chinese_meaning: 大布袋;麻袋;大紙袋;大塑膠袋
example_en: The corn was stored in large sacks.
example_zh: 玉米裝在大麻袋裡。

chinese_meaning: （尤指因與神有關而）神聖的，值得崇敬的
example_en: sacred relics/temples
example_zh: 聖物／殿

example_en: Many women sacrifice interesting careers for their families.
example_zh: 許多女性爲了家庭犧牲了自己感興趣的工作。

chinese_meaning: （基督教教會，尤指天主教教會正式追封的）聖徒，聖者;聖徒頭銜（聖徒的名字有時用作地名或建築物的名稱）
example_en: Saint Peter
example_zh: 聖彼得

example_en: As the saying goes, "Don't count your chickens before they're hatched."
example_zh: 正如俗語所說：「別太早打如意算盤。」

example_en: Food and clean water were becoming scarce.
example_zh: 食物和乾淨的水越來越少了。

chinese_meaning: （使）驚恐，（使）害怕;受驚嚇，感到害怕
example_en: Sudden noises scare her.
example_zh: 突然的響聲把她嚇了一跳。

example_en: an area of outstanding scenic beauty
example_zh: 風景優美的地區

example_en: a classics/history scholar
example_zh: 研究古典文學／歷史的學者

example_en: I'm afraid that problem is beyond/outside the scope of my lecture.
example_zh: 恐怕那個問題超出了我的課程範圍。

chinese_meaning: （一國經濟活動的）部門，領域，行業
example_en: In the financial sector, banks and insurance companies have both lost a lot of money.
example_zh: 在金融領域，銀行和保險公司都損失嚴重。

chinese_meaning: 有選擇性的;嚴格篩選的
example_en: As a teacher she was very selective, accepting only a small number of exceptionally gifted pupils.
example_zh: 作爲老師，她的篩選很嚴格，只接受一小部分特別有天賦的學生。

example_en: The hero of the movie finally finds his true self (= discovers what his true personality and feelings are).
example_zh: 電影的主角最後找到了真正的自我。

example_en: The compliments she received after the presentation boosted her self-esteem.
example_zh: 發言後得到的讚譽增強了她的自尊心。

example_en: The police showed commendable sensitivity in their handling of the case.
example_zh: 警方在處理該案時表現出高度敏銳性，值得讚揚。

chinese_meaning: （重罪案犯或重案）連環的，連續的
example_en: She wrote a thriller about a brutal serial killer/murderer.
example_zh: 她寫了部有關一名冷血連環殺手的驚悚小說。

example_en: Sally had been recovering well from her operation, but yesterday she experienced/suffered a setback.
example_zh: 莎莉手術後一直恢復良好，但昨天她的病情再度復發。

example_en: It now seems unlikely that it will be possible to negotiate/reach a peaceful settlement of the conflict.
example_zh: 現在看來和平解決這一衝突是不可能的。

example_en: He wore a shabby old overcoat.
example_zh: 他穿著一件破舊的大衣。

example_en: I couldn't see anything shameful in what I had done.
example_zh: 我認為我做的事沒什麼丟臉的。

example_en: The suggestion is sheer nonsense.
example_zh: 這個建議純粹是胡言亂語。

example_en: She shifted (her weight) uneasily from one foot to the other.
example_zh: 她不安地把身體的重心由一隻腳轉移到另一隻腳。

example_en: Whatever his shortcomings as a husband, he was a good father to his children.
example_zh: 不管作爲一個丈夫他有何缺點，他卻是孩子們的好父親。

example_en: As you grow older, your spine shortens by about an inch.
example_zh: 隨著年齡變老，你的脊椎將縮短約一吋。

chinese_meaning: 穿梭運行的車輛，接駁車;穿梭航班
example_en: To get across town, you can take the shuttle from Times Square to Grand Central.
example_zh: 要穿越市區，你可以乘坐從時代廣場穿梭到中央車站的穿梭巴士。

example_en: Does this drug have any side effects?
example_zh: 這種藥有甚麽副作用嗎？

example_en: The discovery of the new drug is of great significance for/to people suffering from heart problems.
example_zh: 這種新藥的發現對心臟病患者來說具有重要意義。

example_en: The advantage of the plan is its simplicity.
example_zh: 這項計劃的優點是簡單易行。

example_en: the new simplified tax system
example_zh: 簡化後的新稅制

example_en: The manager prepared a computer simulation of likely sales performance for the rest of the year.
example_zh: 經理準備對該年度剩餘時間內可能的銷售業績進行計算類比分析。

example_en: There were several simultaneous explosions in different cities.
example_zh: 幾起爆炸在幾個不同的城市同時發生。

chinese_meaning: （人、感情或行爲）真誠的，誠實的
example_en: a sincere apology
example_zh: 真誠的道歉

example_en: This tea is very hot, so sip it carefully.
example_zh: 這茶很燙，喝的時候小心點。

example_en: My mother made a (pencil) sketch of my brother reading a book.
example_zh: 我母親畫了一張我弟弟在讀書的（鉛筆）素描。

example_en: army slang
example_zh: 軍隊俚語

example_en: slippery soap
example_zh: 濕滑的肥皂

example_en: an advertising slogan
example_zh: 廣告口號

example_en: I put my money in the slot and pressed the button but nothing came out.
example_zh: 我把錢放入投幣口，按了按鈕，但沒有東西出來。

example_en: Smog is a major problem in Athens.
example_zh: 霧霾是雅典的一個主要問題。

chinese_meaning: 浸濕，把…濕透;（液體）滲入，滲透
example_en: The wind had blown the rain in and soaked the carpet.
example_zh: 雨被風吹進了屋裡，打濕了地毯。

example_en: My sole objective is to make the information more widely available.
example_zh: 我唯一的目的就是讓更多的人能了解到這些資訊。

chinese_meaning: （英國和澳大利亞的）初級律師，事務律師，訴狀律師
example_en: a firm of solicitors
example_zh: 事務律師事務所

example_en: The situation raises important questions about solidarity among member states of the UN.
example_zh: 當前形勢對聯合國成員國能否團結一致這一重要問題提出了質疑。

example_en: a life of solitude
example_zh: 獨居的生活

example_en: The resort has changed somewhat over the last few years.
example_zh: 近幾年來，這個旅遊勝地出現了些變化。

example_en: Sow the seeds in pots.
example_zh: 把這些種子種在花盆裡。

example_en: a spacious house/living room
example_zh: 寬敞的房子／起居室

chinese_meaning: 規格；規範；標準；明細單；詳細說明
example_en: All products are made exactly to the customer's specifications.
example_zh: 所有産品完全按照客戶的具體要求製造。

example_en: Rumours that they are about to marry have been dismissed as pure speculation.
example_zh: 他們打算結婚的傳言已證實只不過是猜測。

example_en: The earth spins on its axis.
example_zh: 地球繞地軸旋轉。

example_en: She injured her spine in a riding accident.
example_zh: 她在一次墜馬事故中脊椎受傷。

chinese_meaning: 極佳的，非常好的；華麗的；壯麗的
example_en: We had splendid food/a splendid holiday/splendid weather.
example_zh: 我們的食物／我們的假期／我們碰到的天氣簡直太棒了。

example_en: A spokesperson for the airline said that flights would run as scheduled.
example_zh: 航空公司的發言人說這些航班將按計劃飛行。

example_en: The orchestra receives £2 million a year in sponsorship from companies.
example_zh: 該樂團每年從這些公司獲得200萬英鎊的贊助費。

example_en: a period of political stability
example_zh: 政治穩定時期

example_en: If the foundations of the house aren't stable, collapse is possible.
example_zh: 如果房子的地基不穩，就有可能倒塌。

chinese_meaning: （建築物內通常帶有扶手的）樓梯
example_en: She descended the sweeping (= long and wide) staircase into the crowd of photographers and journalists.
example_zh: 她走下又長又寬的樓梯，來到攝影師和記者中間。

chinese_meaning: （通常指因久放）不新鮮的，走味的
example_en: The bread/biscuits/cake had gone stale.
example_zh: 麵包／餅乾／蛋糕已經不新鮮了。

example_en: Whole communities starved to death during the long drought.
example_zh: 在這場漫長的大旱中，整個村落的人都餓死了。

example_en: statistical errors/evidence
example_zh: 統計錯誤／證據

example_en: The association works to promote the status of retired people as useful members of the community.
example_zh: 這個協會旨在提高退休人員的地位，使其成為社會中有用的成員。

chinese_meaning: （尤指錯誤的）刻板印象，老套俗見，成見
example_en: racial/sexual stereotypes
example_zh: 陳舊的種族偏見／性別成見

example_en: It is now halfway through winter and food stocks are already low.
example_zh: 現在冬天剛剛過半，但食物的儲備已經不足。

example_en: nylon/silk stockings.
example_zh: 長筒尼龍襪／絲襪

chinese_meaning: 有助於計劃成功的;戰略（性）的
example_en: strategic planning
example_zh: 戰略規劃

example_en: a bale of straw
example_zh: 一捆稻草

example_en: Many people sympathize with the strikers.
example_zh: 許多人同情罷工者。

example_en: We could stroll along the beach after dinner.
example_zh: 晚飯後我們可以去海灘散散步。

example_en: I think my husband is the most handsome man in the world, but I realize my judgment is rather subjective.
example_zh: 我覺得我丈夫是世界上最帥的男人，當然我也意識到我的判斷很主觀。

example_en: The book discusses his illness and subsequent resignation from politics.
example_zh: 書中講述了他患病及隨後隱退政壇的事。

example_en: The company received a substantial government subsidy.
example_zh: 公司得到大筆政府津貼。

example_en: The new rules will substantially change how we do things.
example_zh: 新規則會很大程度地改變我們的行事方式。

example_en: It looks as though the coach is going to make a substitution (= change one player for another in the game).
example_zh: 教練似乎要換人。

chinese_meaning: 繼任者，接替者;繼承人;接替的事物
example_en: The university is seeking a successor to its vice chancellor, who retires this spring.
example_zh: 大學在尋找一位繼任者，接替將於今年復活節退休的校長。

example_en: I'll just summarize the main points of the argument in a few words.
example_zh: 我會用幾句話把爭論的要點概括一下。

chinese_meaning: 好於平均的，好過其他的，優越的
example_en: This is clearly the work of a superior artist.
example_zh: 這顯然是一位優秀藝術家的作品。

example_en: Students are not allowed to handle these chemicals unless they are under the supervision of a teacher.
example_zh: 學生們只有在老師的指導下才能動這些化學物品。

example_en: groups who are generally supportive of the government
example_zh: 一貫擁護政府的組織

chinese_meaning: （等級、水準或重要性）最高（的），至高無上（的）
example_en: the supreme commander of the armed forces
example_zh: 武裝部隊最高統帥

example_en: An unexpected surge in electrical power caused the computer to crash.
example_zh: 突然出現的電壓遽增導致電腦當機。

example_en: The ferry service has been suspended for the day because of bad weather.
example_zh: 因為天氣惡劣，渡船已經停開。

chinese_meaning: 可持續的，能長期保持的
example_en: That sort of extreme diet is not sustainable over a long period.
example_zh: 那種極端的飲食方式無法長期堅持。

example_en: When you've finished reading your book, and I've finished mine, can we swap?
example_zh: 我們看完各自的書之後，交換一下，好嗎?

chinese_meaning: （尤指在非洲進行的）觀察野生動物之行，狩獵
example_en: to go/be on safari
example_zh: 去／在觀察野生動物

example_en: The union safeguards the interests of all its members.
example_zh: 工會捍衛每位成員的利益。

chinese_meaning: （尤指因經驗豐富而）明智的，睿智的
example_en: sage advice
example_zh: 明智的忠告

example_en: Whenever you see an officer, you must salute.
example_zh: 只要見到軍官就必須敬禮。

chinese_meaning: （尤指從失事船隻、火災或水災中）搶救，打撈
example_en: gold coins salvaged from a shipwreck
example_zh: 從船隻殘骸中打撈出的金幣

chinese_meaning: 救助（途徑）； 解救（辦法）
example_en: After the diagnosis, getting to know Mary was his salvation.
example_zh: 調查分析一番之後，他意識到結識瑪麗是他唯一的出路。

example_en: Many nations have imposed sanctions on the country because of its attacks on its own people.
example_zh: 由於該國發生了對本國人民施暴，許多國家都對其進行制裁。

chinese_meaning: 庇護，保護;避難所，庇護所
example_en: Illegal immigrants found/sought/took sanctuary in a local church.
example_zh: 非法移民把當地的一座教堂當作避難所。

example_en: Many illnesses in these temporary refugee camps are the result of inadequate sanitation.
example_zh: 這些臨時難民營中許多疾病都源於排汙設施不完善。

example_en: The protesters scattered at the sound of gunshots.
example_zh: 聽到槍聲後抗議者就散開了。

example_en: a measuring scoop
example_zh: 量匙

example_en: She has nothing but scorn for the new generation of politicians.
example_zh: 她對新一代的政客只有鄙視。

example_en: Scrape your boots clean before you come in.
example_zh: 進來前先把靴子擦乾淨。

example_en: The ancient Egyptians stored information on scrolls.
example_zh: 古埃及人把資訊記載在捲軸上。

chinese_meaning: （尤指用硬刷、肥皂和水）擦洗，刷洗
example_en: She scrubbed (at) the mark on the wall for a long time, but it wouldn't come off.
example_zh: 她花了很長時間擦洗牆上的印跡，但仍然沒有擦掉。

example_en: Henry Moore, who died in 1986, is one of Britain's best-known sculptors.
example_zh: 1986年去世的亨利‧摩爾是英國最著名的雕塑家之一。

chinese_meaning: 海產，海鮮（尤指魚或貝類）

example_en: a flock of seagulls
example_zh: 一群海鷗

chinese_meaning: （尤指縫合兩塊布或皮革的）線縫，接縫
example_en: The bags we sell have very strong seams, so they will last for years.
example_zh: 我們賣的袋子縫線處非常牢固，所以經久耐用。

example_en: a seasoned traveller
example_zh: 經驗豐富的旅行者

example_en: Taste the soup and adjust the seasoning, adding more salt or pepper as desired.
example_zh: 嚐一下湯，調好佐料，根據口味再加些鹽或胡椒粉。

example_en: The content of her report is shrouded in secrecy (= being kept secret).
example_zh: 她的報告內容依然保秘。

example_en: The seductions of life in a warm climate have led many Britons to live abroad, especially in Spain.
example_zh: 很多英國人禁不住溫暖氣候的誘惑，移居海外，尤其是到西班牙。

example_en: It was a seductive black evening dress.
example_zh: 這是一件性感的黑色晚禮服。

chinese_meaning: 貌似…的；看似…的；（尤指）表面上的
example_en: He said, with seeming embarrassment, that he would have to cancel the meeting.
example_zh: 他看起來有些尷尬地說，他將不得不取消會議。

chinese_meaning: （尤指基於種族或性別原因）隔離並差別對待
example_en: The system of racial segregation that used to exist in South Africa was called apartheid.
example_zh: 南非曾經實施的把種族隔離開來的制度被稱為種族隔離制度。

example_en: Semiconductors are used for making integrated circuits and computers.
example_zh: 半導體用於製造積體電路和電腦。

chinese_meaning: 分裂主義者，分離主義者

example_en: The Reverend William Cronshaw delivered/preached the sermon.
example_zh: 威廉‧克朗肖牧師進行了佈道。

chinese_meaning: （尤指來自別國的）移居者，定居者;殖民者

example_en: a sewer pipe
example_zh: 排水管

example_en: She said that many adults are in denial about adolescent sexuality.
example_zh: 她說，許多成年人否認青少年的性行為。

example_en: We sat on the shady grass for our picnic.
example_zh: 我們坐在陰涼的草地上野餐。

example_en: the shaft of a golf club
example_zh: 高爾夫球桿的柄

example_en: Shareholders will be voting on the proposed merger of the companies next week.
example_zh: 股東們下星期將投票表決擬議中的公司合併問題。

example_en: The glass shattered into a thousand tiny pieces.
example_zh: 玻璃碎成無數塊細小的碎片。

example_en: The farmer taught her how to shear sheep.
example_zh: 那個農夫教了她如何剪羊毛。

example_en: a shepherd boy
example_zh: 牧羊童

chinese_meaning: 雪利酒（烈性葡萄酒，通常餐前飲用，顔色從淺黃色至褐色不一）
example_en: sweet/dry sherry
example_zh: 甜／不甜的雪利酒

chinese_meaning: 先令（英國1971年前使用的一種貨幣單位，合12舊便士或5新便士）

example_en: a shining silver cup
example_zh: 一個閃亮的銀杯

example_en: A shipment of urgent medical supplies is expected to arrive very soon.
example_zh: 一批急需的藥品預計很快就到。

example_en: I know a shortcut to town.
example_zh: 我知道一條去城裡的近路。

example_en: She was jostled and shoved by an angry crowd as she left the court.
example_zh: 她離開法庭時，被憤怒的人群推來搡去。

example_en: There's still a shred of hope that a peace agreement can be reached.
example_zh: 達成和平協議仍存有一絲希望。

example_en: Islam's most sacred shrine is at Mecca in Saudi Arabia.
example_zh: 伊斯蘭教最神聖的聖殿位於沙烏地阿拉伯的麥加。

example_en: She planted some roses and other flowering shrubs.
example_zh: 她種了一些玫瑰及其他一些開花灌木。

example_en: I love shuffling through the fallen leaves.
example_zh: 我喜歡在落葉上曳足而行。

example_en: She has shunned publicity since she retired from acting.
example_zh: 告別舞臺生涯後，她便遠離了大眾的注意。

example_en: The siege of Mafeking lasted for eight months.
example_zh: 對馬弗京的圍攻持續了八個月。

example_en: Nobody really knows what the marks on the ancient stones signify.
example_zh: 沒人真正知道那些古老石頭上的記號代表甚麽含意。

example_en: Leave the vegetables to simmer for a few minutes.
example_zh: 把蔬菜再燉幾分鐘。

example_en: In cheap furniture, plastic is often used to simulate wood.
example_zh: 廉價傢俱經常用塑膠模仿木材。

example_en: The ruined house had a sinister appearance.
example_zh: 那棟倒塌的房子外觀給人一種不祥之感。

example_en: Maybe your world view is a little skewed.
example_zh: 也許你對世界的認知有點不準確。

example_en: The birds skimmed (across/along/over) the tops of the waves.
example_zh: 鳥兒從浪頭上飛過。

example_en: You should eat more - you're too skinny.
example_zh: 你應該多吃點，你太瘦了。

example_en: John is (the) skipper of the team this year.
example_zh: 約翰是今年球隊的隊長。

example_en: I thought the skit on politicians was really funny.
example_zh: 我覺得這齣諷刺政客的幽默短劇確實很好笑。

example_en: These tent ropes are too slack - they need tightening.
example_zh: 這些帳篷繩太鬆了——需要把它們拉緊。

example_en: The museum was broken into last night and several paintings were slashed.
example_zh: 昨晚有人闖進了博物館，有幾幅畫被劃破了。

chinese_meaning: 板岩，石板;（蓋屋頂的）石板瓦

example_en: William Wilberforce campaigned for the abolition of slavery.
example_zh: 威廉·威伯福斯致力於廢除奴隸制。

example_en: St George slew the dragon.
example_zh: 聖喬治殺死了那條龍。

example_en: Manilow gave the slick, polished performance that we've come to expect.
example_zh: 正如我們所期望的那樣，馬尼洛的表演揮灑自如、技藝精湛。
